preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of nodes n in each test case must be between 1 and 200000.
The total number of nodes across all test cases must not exceed 200000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct nodes within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output relabeling must be a permutation of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= relabeling[i] <= n for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each element in the relabeling must be a valid node number between 1 and n.
The relabeling must contain all unique node numbers from 1 to n.
